name: Raid on the Kolkar
summary: After Strange Alliance, Uthek the Wise sends you against the Kolkar centaurs to the northeast. Kill them, take their charms, and bring ten of those charms back to Uthek.

sections.title: Contempt for Kolkar Magic
sections.body: Uthek scoffs at the Kolkar centaurs for thinking their magic strong; in Uthek's view they know nothing of magic. You go northeast to the Kolkar, kill them, and take their charms. Uthek wants ten Crude Charms to throw in the fire, laughing as they burn.

sections.title: Uthek's Verdict
sections.body: Uthek praises the deed as a good one for the Gelkis. The Kolkar are feeble and doomed, Uthek says, and their magic will not save them. Having seen your work, they will fear all the more, and fear makes them feebler. In Gelkis lands, the feeble soon die.

aliases: who gives raid on the kolkar
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise waits in Gelkis Village in Desolace. Uthek wants the Kolkar's charms.
To the northeast, according to Uthek.
Charms taken from the Kolkar. Uthek wants ten of them to throw in the fire and laugh.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Gelkis chain?
